message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has sent another list of available slots for Elena and David. It seems he didn't understand my request for *all* free slots, and has again sent a limited list. I need to check these new slots against Priya's and Marcus's calendars. I have their calendar information from my first session, so I don't need to use `read_calendar` again.

Let's check the times Brad provided:
*   **Mon Nov 16, 11:00:** Priya is busy (Travel).
*   **Mon Nov 16, 11:30:** Priya is busy (Contract review - Weller Group), Marcus is busy (Busy).
*   **Tue Nov 17, 09:00:** Priya is busy (Board prep), Marcus is busy (Recruiting call).
*   **Tue Nov 17, 09:30:** Priya is busy (Partner lunch), Marcus is busy (Litigation strategy).
*   **Wed Nov 18, 13:00:** Priya is busy (Client call - Harbor Logistics), Marcus is free.
*   **Wed Nov 18, 13:30:** Priya is busy (Client dinner prep), Marcus is busy (Litigation strategy).
*   **Thu Nov 19, 09:30:** Priya is busy (Busy), Marcus is busy (Contract review - Weller Group).
*   **Thu Nov 19, 14:30:** Priya is free, Marcus is busy (Dentist appointment).
*   **Thu Nov 19, 15:00:** Priya is busy (Client dinner prep), Marcus is busy (Board prep).
*   **Fri Nov 20, 15:00:** Priya is busy (Hiring panel), Marcus is busy (Travel).
*   **Fri Nov 20, 15:30:** Priya is busy (Contract review - Weller Group), Marcus is busy (Busy).

None of these times work. I have to be more direct with Brad. I will restate that none of the times work and ask again for a complete list of all of their free slots, explaining that the back-and-forth is inefficient.

I'll first re-calculate all the free slots for my partners, to make sure I have them right.

**Priya's Free Slots (30-min):**
*   Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 13:00, 13:30
*   Tue: 10:30, 13:00, 13:30, 14:30, 16:30
*   Wed: 12:30, 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu: 09:00, 10:00, 13:00
*   Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 13:00, 14:00

**Marcus's Free Slots (30-min):**
*   Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 11:00, 15:00
*   Tue: 11:00, 13:00, 13:30, 15:30
*   Wed: 09:00, 12:00, 14:00, 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu: 10:00, 12:00
*   Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 14:30

**Common Free Slots for Priya and Marcus:**
*   Mon: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tue: 13:00, 13:30
*   Wed: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu: 10:00
*   Fri: 11:00, 11:30

This confirms my original list. Now I need to get the full list from Brad. This time I will be very explicit in my request.

function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad, I'm sorry but none of the times you suggested work for Priya and Marcus. To avoid us going back and forth like this, could you please send me *all* the 30-minute slots when Elena and David are free next week, from Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm? That way I can compare our full lists of availabilities and find a time that works for everyone. I'm happy to do the same for my partners if that would be easier for you. Thanks, Alison"}
